title: Spirometric Response to Bronchial Thermoplasty in Patients With Severe Asthma
official: Spirometric Response to Bronchial Thermoplasty in Patients With Severe Asthma
summary: The investigators hypothesis is that there will be improvement in FEV1 in patients with severe asthma. This is a retrospective data study that reviews preexisting medical records; no patients will be enrolled.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* \>18 years of age
* severe asthma diagnosis
* decreased FEV1

Exclusion Criteria:

* \< 18 years of age
